scenes.headline: How a frozen model rewrites its own harness
scenes.sub: And why the search for a better harness has to be regularized.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Ottoline! An agent is a frozen model wrapped in a harness. This method lets it rewrite that harness, and keeps the search honest.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: Keep the harness fully editable, but regularize how the search moves through it.
scenes.say: Most methods keep whatever edit raises the score. Round after round on the same tasks, that memorises them. This one regularises the search instead.

steps.say: Start from the current harness. A proposer reads the failed runs and drafts an edit, but a budget caps how many changes it bundles.
Each candidate is one attributable edit, tagged with the component it touches and the hypothesis it tests.
Before scoring, a critic reads the diff. Anything that hard-codes the benchmark's own task names is rejected here.
What survives is scored. A noise floor drops gains too small to tell from noise; a cost rule drops tokens the gain does not pay for.
Only an edit that clears every gate becomes the next harness. Dead components get pruned, and the loop repeats.

left.title: Score-only
left.say: Score-only evolution keeps whatever tops the evolve score. It memorises the benchmark, and gains vanish on new tasks.

right.title: Regularized
right.say: The regularized search keeps only what clears the gates. A reusable mechanism survives, a benchmark trick does not, so gains transfer.

scenes.label: Terminal-Bench, up from 74.2
scenes.note: the coding split it evolved on
scenes.say: On the coding split it searched, the harness takes its score from seventy-four point two to eighty point two.

scenes.label: on a benchmark it never scored
scenes.say: And the gains transfer. On a workspace benchmark the search never saw, the harness gains up to four point seven points.

scenes.text: Self-improvement is a generalization problem: gate what becomes permanent, not what the harness may hold.

recap: Gate edits, not the edit space
scenes.say: Leave the edit space open, gate what becomes permanent, and the harness improves on work the search never saw. See you next time.
